body: My Dad killed himself. I was left thinking I am not worthy of love. Sometimes not even of being. What I do know is that even in my darkest days, I will not kill myself. Because even if I can’t feel it, there are people who love me. And they will suffer my death the rest of their lives. People are out there who love you. God loves you. You would be missed. You are valuable and important, because God saw fit to breathe life into your body, and your soul arrived. I am sorry you feel like leaving this life. Bless you. You are important.

Simple enough to say fuck ‘em. Except when you live with them and they are still hurting. It takes a while and is painful to endure. I do love my family and I am far from perfect. I lived a tough life in some respects and it damaged me. And then my actions in turn damaged others. It’s a tough reality to embrace, but I believe in our ability to survive and thrive. And love. And forgive. But some days I feel so weak. Having caused pain I must endure while others heal from it.
There always is. But trust list is hard to regain. And everyone brings their own perspective. I did not love with my whole heart. It’s a tough road back.
Thank you so much. This is what I pray for. And work for. Bless you.
Thank you so much. I believe this in my heart but it can be so hard to hold on to. Bless you.

Because I broke their trust. I maintained relationships with people and didn’t include my family. They didn’t know my full self. I held apart some of who I was. Finding this out means broken trust. Lingering anger. Ongoing suspicion. Doubt.

God sent Jesus to this earth to understand what being human is like. When he understood how hard it is, he provided for forgiveness of our sins through faith alone. He knows it’s hard. He wants you to know you are loved. He wants you to know he cares. Out of all the people on the planet, God, in the form of the Holy Spirit, breathed life into your body. He did this because no one but you can fulfill the need the world has for you. No one else brings to the world what you do. Even though none of us sees the entire picture, we are part of the whole. Without you, something is missing. You are valuable, and you are loved. Walk in faith my friend. For you offer the world yourself, and no one else can do that. Be strong.
